item.title: HTB: Cicada
item.description: Windows box, no web server. Everything comes from SMB and LDAP, one credential leading to the next. It’s a nice example of how a single operational security mistake - a default password in an HR notice, a cleartext password in an AD description, credentials embedded in a script - cascades into domain compromise. The escalation at the end via Backup Operators and SeBackupPrivilege is a classic that deserves proper understanding.
